title: Print the number of companies
description:
Print the number of companies in the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as company_count(companies), returning the number of companies in the list.
hints: You need a count of the elements in the companies list.
The built-in length function works on any list.
expected_behavior: Returns the number of items in the companies list.
explanation: len() reports how many items the companies list currently holds.
